summary: Iter 10 security regression run completed for backend+frontend. 13 backend security tests executed: 11 passed, 2 failed. Mobile web login flow validated that demo/admin hints are not disclosed and former demo phone 9999999999 does not navigate to OTP when provider is unavailable.

critical.issue: Rate limit did not trigger 429 on rapid repeated requests while SMS provider is unavailable; endpoint consistently returned 503, so request throttling is bypassed in this path.

Configured preview origin preflight is rejected with 400 'Disallowed CORS origin'. Additionally, GET /api/auth/config responded with Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * in this environment, indicating CORS behavior drift/inconsistency.

action_items: Move/enforce auth request throttling before provider-availability fail-closed branch in /api/auth/request-otp so rapid abuse still reaches 429.
Fix CORS allowlist behavior for preview origin at runtime (preflight should succeed only for configured origin and fail for others consistently).
Audit ingress/proxy CORS overrides because API GET responses currently expose wildcard Access-Control-Allow-Origin in this environment.
Update /app/memory/test_credentials.md security notes: it still documents demo OTP/public demo behavior that no longer matches patched security posture.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py sets default JWT secret fallback ('dev_secret'); security policy should fail fast if JWT_SECRET is missing instead of defaulting.
frontend/src/api.ts uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL; project policy references EXPO_BACKEND_URL naming for backend URL source consistency.
Current CORS behavior appears split between app middleware and upstream proxy headers, causing contradictory preflight vs GET behavior.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for tested security UI checks (2/2 core checks passed)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Use /app/backend/tests/test_iter10_security_regression.py as baseline. If CORS is fixed, rerun with exported frontend/.env and verify both OPTIONS preflight and actual browser-origin fetch behavior.
rca_of_issue: RCA1: request-otp throttling executes after provider-enabled guard in server.py, so when SMS provider is off it returns 503 before counting attempts, preventing 429. RCA2: runtime CORS behavior is inconsistent (preflight rejects configured preview origin, but GET shows wildcard ACAO), suggesting allowlist mismatch and/or upstream proxy CORS header injection overriding backend intent.
